_about: USD per 1M tokens. Read by usage.py `price`. Lookup order: this file -> the runner's own table ($RUNNERS_DIR/devin/prices.json, $RUNNERS_DIR/scripts/claude-prices.json) -> OpenRouter public list (cached 24h). Missing cache_read = 0.1 x input, missing cache_write = 1.25 x input. A free route is priced as its paid twin: the point is the API-equivalent cost.
_aliases_about: Ids that do not match an OpenRouter id by name. Key = id as the runner prints it (provider prefix, effort suffix and -free are stripped first; dots and dashes are treated alike). 'id@provider' applies only to that provider (Cesego labels DeepSeek V4.1 Flash as deepseek-v4-flash). Value = the id to price it as.
